summary: Tested the enhanced Rura AI assistant (backend /api/ai/chat + /asistente UI) and ran regressions from iteration_4. Backend: 7/7 passed (1 discount test skipped locally because it hit the /admin/discount-codes path; the exact race test from iteration_4 was re-run separately and passed 3/3). Frontend: all critical flows passed — disclaimer banner, 4 quick prompts including the vaca prompt, urgency banner for vet emergency, veterinario CTA (/servicios?category=salud_animal), agronomo CTA (/servicios?category=agronomia), no CTA for marketing questions, and NO raw [[PRO/URGENT/TOPIC]] tags leaked in any visible reply.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1520 lines; consider splitting into routers (ai, products, memberships, discount-codes, articles) to stay under 700-line guideline.
AI system prompt + tag parsing could be extracted to a small helper module (ai_prompt.py) for unit-testability of the regex.
seed_data_creation: None required. Discount code tests in iteration_4 create and consume codes under admin and clean them in their own teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 focused on Rura AI assistant. Backend test file is /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py — it covers vet-urgent, vet-non-urgent, agronomo, marketing (ninguno) classification, no-tag-leak in reply, and clean history. Playwright flow logs into campesino, visits /asistente, sends vet/agronomy/marketing prompts and checks urgency banner + pro-CTA chip presence/absence. Claude responses are non-deterministic; one occasional mismatch for non-urgent vet (returns 'ninguno' instead of 'veterinario') is tolerated by the test.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Minor test-authoring note: `[data-testid^="msg-a_"]` matches both the message container and its nested -urgent / -pro-cta children, so counting assistant messages via this prefix is unreliable. Future tests should either count `[data-testid^="msg-u_"]` user bubbles or gate on `[data-testid="ai-typing"]` visibility.
